name: Countdown sample
description: One local countdown shared by configured Start, Pause and Reset actions and a passive status face. No account, alarm sound or external service.

contributions.name: Countdown action
contributions.description: Start or resume, pause, or reset the shared countdown. Duration applies to a fresh start or reset. The face shows time remaining.

contributions.name: Countdown status
contributions.description: Display the shared countdown without an action. Suitable for the middle of a ring.
